title: Passport renewal planner
subtitle: Adult passport · applying in Canada
error.title: We couldn’t build your plan right now
error.body: The official renewal page has everything you need, and we’ll try again when you ask.
saved.label: Passport renewal plan
footnote.device: Saving keeps this plan on this device only. Never enter your passport number here.
handoff.newNote: A new application needs a guarantor and proof of citizenship.
handoff.note.online: You’ll sign in to the IRCC Portal to apply and pay.
handoff.note.in-person: Book an appointment or walk in to a passport office or Service Canada Centre.
handoff.note.mail: Download form PPTC 054, then mail it with your photos, passport and payment.
need.title: What you’ll need
need.photoDigital.title: A digital passport photo
need.photoDigital.detail: Taken in person by a commercial photographer, no more than 6 months old. Not a scan of a printed photo.
need.photos.title: 2 printed passport photos
need.photos.detail: The photographer writes or stamps their studio name, address and the date on the back of one. No guarantor signature needed.
need.form.title: Form {form}
need.form.detail: The adult passport renewal form. Fill it out on a computer, then print and sign it.
need.passport.title: Your current passport
need.passport.online: Keep it handy. It’s cancelled as soon as you apply, so apply in person if you travel before the new one arrives.
need.passport.paper: You send or bring it with your application.
need.refs.title: {count} references
need.refs.detail: Adults 18 or older who’ve known you for at least 2 years. Not your spouse or partner, immediate family or in-laws, or other relatives who live with you.
need.portal.title: An IRCC Portal account
need.portal.detail: You’ll sign in or register on the official site, then pay by card.
need.payment.title: Payment for the fee
need.payment.inPerson: Credit, debit or prepaid card, certified cheque or money order. No cash.
need.payment.mail: Credit card or embossed prepaid card on the form, or a certified cheque or money order.
elig.title: Can you renew?
elig.issuedAt16OrOlder: I was 16 or older when it was issued
elig.issuedWithin15Years: It was issued in the last {years} years
elig.validFor5or10Years: It was valid for 5 or 10 years
elig.sameDetails: Same name, birth date, birthplace and gender identifier
elig.skip: You’ll skip the guarantor, proof of citizenship and supporting ID.
elig.newNeeded: If any of these isn’t true, you need to apply for a new passport instead of renewing.
how.title: How to apply
validity.label: Passport validity
stat.processingNote.in-person: At a passport office · 20 at a regular Service Canada Centre
stat.processingNote.mail: After it arrives · plus mailing time
notes.online.1: Open while your passport expires within 6 months, or is already expired.
notes.online.2: Your current passport must be a regular (blue) one that shows your place of birth, and your home and mailing address must be in Canada.
notes.online.3: Your current passport is cancelled when you apply, so don’t apply online if you travel in the next 20 business days.
notes.in-person.1: Fastest option. Urgent and express service are available at passport offices for an extra fee.
notes.in-person.2: Book an appointment online or walk in. You may need to show proof of travel for faster service.
notes.in-person.3: Your passport is mailed to you unless you pay {pickup} to pick it up at a passport office.
notes.mail.1: Mail form PPTC 054 with your photos, current passport and payment.
notes.mail.2: Use a traceable mail or courier service to protect your documents.
notes.mail.3: Processing starts when your application arrives, plus mailing time both ways.
online.unavailable.too-early: Online renewal isn’t open for you yet.
online.unavailable.travel-soon: Online renewal isn’t a good fit before your trip.
online.unavailable.outside-canada: Online renewal needs a home and mailing address in Canada.
online.opens: It opens on {date}, 6 months before your passport expires. You can apply in person or by mail any time.
online.tryInPerson: Apply in person instead. It’s the fastest option.
verdict.yesSub: No guarantor, no proof of citizenship, no supporting ID.
verdict.noSub: Renewal only works when every check below is true. Applying for a new passport takes a few more documents.
verdict.onlineOpen: Online renewal is open to you
verdict.onlineLater: Online renewal opens on {date}. In person or by mail works any time.
verdict.travelSoon: You’re travelling {date}, so apply in person.
timeline.monthsLeft: {count, plural, one {month until it expires} other {months until it expires}}
timeline.spare: {count, plural, =0 {Cutting it close} one {About # month to spare} other {About # months to spare}}
step.inHandDetail: Mailed to you, usually 5 business days
timeline.sr: Today is {today}. If you apply today, your new passport should be ready around {ready} and in your hands around {inHand}. Your current passport expires in {expiry}.
estimate.withHolidays: Estimate counts business days from today and skips {holidays}. Delivery usually adds 5 business days.
estimate.plain: Estimate counts business days from today, skipping weekends and statutory holidays. Delivery usually adds 5 business days.
picker.title: When does your passport expire?
picker.sub: Pick the month printed on your passport. We’ll map out your dates, on this device only.
verdict.onlineDepends: Online renewal opens 6 months before your passport expires.
online.unavailable.unknown-expiry: Online renewal depends on when your passport expires.
timeline.monthsSince: {count, plural, =0 {expired this month} one {month since it expired} other {months since it expired}}
step.expiredDetail: Your passport has expired. You can still renew it.
timeline.srExpired: Your passport expired in {expiry}. Today is {today}. If you apply today, your new passport should be ready around {ready} and in your hands around {inHand}.
footnote.saved: Saved on this device only, and you can clear it any time. Never enter your passport number here.
handoff.note.unknown: Add your expiry month above to see if you can renew online.
handoff.note.onlineInfo: Read who can renew online. In person or by mail works any time.
handoff.note.urgent: Check what to bring for urgent or express service at a passport office.
status.none: No service notices on canada.ca’s passport page · checked {date}
status.offline: Before you apply, check canada.ca for passport service notices
stat.mailNote: After it arrives · mailing time not included
verdict.outsideCanada: Online renewal needs a home and mailing address in Canada.
timeline.spareTrip: {count, plural, =0 {Arrives the day of your trip} one {# day before your trip} other {# days before your trip}}
step.tripDetail: You need your passport by this date
estimate.mail: By mail, we allow about 5 business days for your application to arrive (our estimate, the same as the delivery back to you). Processing starts when it arrives. Use tracked mail.
trip.express: Regular processing won’t get your passport to you in time. At a passport office, express pick-up is ready in 2 to 9 business days (by {date} at the latest), for {fee} on top of the passport fee.
trip.urgent: Regular processing won’t get your passport to you in time. At a passport office, urgent pick-up is ready by the end of the next business day ({date}), for {fee} on top of the passport fee.
trip.proof: Bring proof of travel, like an airline, bus or train ticket or a travel itinerary showing proof of payment.
trip.link: Urgent, express and emergency service on canada.ca
notes.online.4: It can’t be damaged, seized or surrendered, or have observations in it (notes on a separate page, like a name too long to print in full).
step.mailInDetail: Our estimate. Processing starts when it arrives.
step.todayHoliday.online: Offices closed today ({name}) · apply online now, or in person from {date}
step.todayHoliday.office: Offices closed today ({name}) · apply in person from {date}
estimate.holidayToday: Passport offices are closed today for {name}, so in-person dates count from {date}.
fees.title: Adult passport fees
fees.sub: Applying in Canada · in effect since {date}
fees.urgentNote: By end of next business day
handoff.note.fees: See the fee for your situation and how to pay it.
trip.emergency.title: Urgent pick-up can’t be ready before you leave on {date}
trip.emergency.urgent: Urgent pick-up, the fastest service at a passport office, is ready by the end of the next business day ({date}). That’s too late for your trip.
trip.emergency.askHoliday: Call the Passport Program and ask about emergency weekend or statutory holiday service. It’s only for emergencies, when you have to travel over that weekend or holiday.
trip.emergency.ask: Call the Passport Program as soon as you can and ask how to get your passport in time. Extra fees may apply.
trip.contact: Get the phone number on canada.ca
handoff.note.processing: See service standards for every way to apply.
handoff.note.onlineFocus: Read every condition, then sign in to the IRCC Portal if you qualify.
stat.rushNote.emergency: The fastest service at a passport office, and too late for your trip

timeline.srEmergency: Today is {today}. Urgent pick-up would be ready {ready}, after your trip on {trip}, so call the Passport Program.

legend.rush.urgent: Urgent pick-up, at a passport office

step.emergencyToday: Call the Passport Program as soon as you can
step.pickUpDetail.urgent: Urgent pick-up · by the end of the next business day
step.urgentLate: After you leave, so too late for your trip
estimate.rush: Pick-up dates count business days from when passport offices open, skipping weekends and statutory holidays.
estimate.express: Some offices need at least 3 or 4 business days for express pick-up.
proc.title: Processing time
proc.sub: Business days, applying in Canada, not counting mailing time
proc.other: Online, by mail or at a regular Service Canada Centre
proc.mailing: Unless you pick it up, mailing your passport to you usually adds 5 business days.
onl.title: Yes, if your passport expires within 6 months or has already expired.
onl.openBy: Open to you today if yours expires by {date}.
onl.c1: A regular (blue) passport, valid 5 or 10 years, that shows your place of birth
onl.c2: A home and mailing address in Canada
onl.c3: No travel in the next 20 business days
onl.c4: A digital photo from a commercial photographer, no more than 6 months old
onl.cancelled: Your current passport is cancelled as soon as you apply online.
timeline.srRush.express: Today is {today}. With express pick-up at a passport office, your passport should be ready to pick up by {ready}, before your trip on {trip}.
timeline.srRush.urgent: Today is {today}. With urgent pick-up at a passport office, your passport should be ready to pick up by {ready}, before your trip on {trip}.
trip.emergency.proof: You must provide proof you need the passport, like an airline, bus or train ticket or a travel itinerary showing proof of payment.
tripDate.label: Travelling before it arrives? Add your departure date
estimate.early: Renewing more than a year before it expires? You’ll be asked the reason.
estimate.earlyMail: By mail, include a written explanation.
notes.rush.1: {kind, select, express {Ask for express pick-up when you apply in person. You pick up your passport at the office, so there’s no mailing time.} urgent {Ask for urgent pick-up when you apply in person. Your passport is ready by the end of the next business day, and you pick it up at the office, so there’s no mailing time.} other {You can ask for faster service when you apply in person, or after you apply if you now need your passport sooner.}}
notes.rush.2: Driving? A written statement explaining why you need to travel counts as proof.
notes.rush.3: The Passport Program can’t guarantee you’ll get it in time, for example if your application is incomplete. Don’t finalize travel plans until you have it.
timeline.daysLeft: {count, plural, =0 {days: you leave today} one {day until you leave} other {days until you leave}}

trip.emergency.phone.open: It answers calls Monday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. your local time (9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. in Newfoundland).
trip.emergency.phone.callback: Call now and leave a message asking for a call-back. The Passport Program calls back with information on emergency services between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. your local time.
trip.emergency.phone.holiday: Its lines are closed today for the statutory holiday. They open {date} at 8:30 a.m. your local time (9 a.m. in Newfoundland).
trip.emergency.phone.closed: Its lines are closed for today. They open {date} at 8:30 a.m. your local time (9 a.m. in Newfoundland).
trip.emergency.tonight: After 5 p.m. today (5:30 p.m. in Newfoundland), leave a message asking for a call-back.
trip.emergency.weekend: On Saturday or Sunday, leave a message asking for a call-back.
trip.emergency.fee: Emergency weekend or holiday service costs {fee} on top of the passport fee. Family members who need it at the same time each pay a {urgent} urgent service fee.
plan.title: Plan my renewal
plan.summary: Pick your expiry month to see your dates, how to apply and what you’ll need.
trip.plan.title: Know when your passport expires?
trip.plan.sub: Add the month to see whether you can renew online and to put the expiry on your timeline.
tripDate.past: That date has passed. Enter today or a later date.
trip.emergency.holidayNote: You can still try leaving a message asking for a call-back. canada.ca offers that on weekends and on the evening before a holiday, but doesn’t mention the holiday itself.
footnote.private: What you pick here stays on this device. Never enter your passport number here.
elig.reviewSub: All ticked. Untick any that isn’t true for your passport.
trip.expressMaybe: Express pick-up ({fee}) can be ready in as few as 2 business days, but it can take up to 9 ({date}), after you leave. Ask the passport office if it can be ready in time. Urgent pick-up is the safer choice.
notes.title.in-person: Applying in person: what to know
notes.title.mail: Applying by mail: what to know
notes.rush.expressToo: Express pick-up (+{fee}) costs less. Ask the office if it can have your passport ready before you leave.
trip.urgentFrom: Regular processing won’t get your passport to you in time. Passport offices next open {open}. Apply then, and urgent pick-up is ready by the end of the following business day ({date}), for {fee} on top of the passport fee.
trip.emergency.urgentFrom: Passport offices next open {open}. Urgent pick-up, the fastest service there, is ready by the end of the following business day ({date}). That’s too late for your trip.
estimate.afterHours: It’s late in the day, so in-person dates count from {date}, the next day passport offices are open.
estimate.closedToday: Passport offices are closed today, so in-person dates count from {date}.

step.rushLater: Apply in person at a passport office on {date}, with proof of travel

timeline.srOpensNoExpiry: Today is {today}. Passport offices next open on {opens}. If you apply in person on {opens}, your new passport should be ready around {ready} and in your hands around {inHand}.
timeline.srOpensExpired: Your passport expired in {expiry}. Today is {today}. Passport offices next open on {opens}. If you apply in person on {opens}, your new passport should be ready around {ready} and in your hands around {inHand}.
